scope: Bilingual 34-second cinematic product preview; not a public integrated-product download launch.
director_findings_zh: 开场直接进入音乐与歌词板，Nearpane名称从首镜存在，品牌关系连续。
核心来自真实原生连续录屏；自动换句、悬停、真实进度拖动、暂停与恢复均清楚可见。
歌词板占主要体验时间；Riftlet以官方图标与短标识作辅助出场，没有伪造安装或完整Riftlet工作流。
中文与英文按各自真实录屏节奏剪辑；竖屏重新布局，未作中心裁切。
原生空文字过渡保留卡片，只有源中最终持续撤下后才留空；修复了透明判定与帧边界舍入问题。
片尾Nearpane、真实官网与产品预览行动指引明确。

director_export_review.method: Actual encoded contact frames inspected for both 4K and portrait outputs, plus dense independent temporal review of both 1080p edits; final CFR correction frames extracted from all four masters and visually checked.
director_export_review.scope_note: This is frame-based visual review and complete technical decode, not real-time subjective audio/video playback.

technical_result: All six delivered MP4s fully decode; full films are exactly 34s/30fps, H.264 yuv420p Rec709 limited range with AAC 48kHz stereo; -16.00 LUFS and -1.50 dBTP for all full films.
resolution_limit: 4K output canvas; native product recording crop is genuine Retina 416x384, not a claim of 4K native UI pixels.
not_verified: Subjective listening review in this runtime.
Final current Nearpane Host release acceptance and signed public installer.
not_shown: Successful next/previous button click in the final control movies; buttons are visible and capability has separate source tests.
